question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "**literal**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The given passage refers to the concept of Democracy.**
 
• **Now, the blank 3 will express what the word "democracy" actually means.**
 
• **In the given question, the blank needs to be filled with a word that conveys a straightforward meaning, without any figurative language or exaggeration.**
 
• Therefore, option 4, "literal", is the correct answer.
 
 
• ​"Literal" means taking words in their usual or most basic sense, without metaphor or exaggeration.(शाब्दिक)
 
• Example: A literal translation of the name Tapies is 'walls'.
 
 
 
• The other given options do not fit the context of the given sentence.

Hence,** the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "metaphorical", means using a word or phrase to represent something else, often in a symbolic or abstract way.(बामुहावरा)
 
• Option 2, "hyperbole", means exaggerated statements or claims not meant to be taken literally.(अतिशयोक्ति)
 
• Option 3, "figurative", means using words or expressions with a meaning that is different from the literal interpretation.(आलंकारिक)
